purpose: Teach: 風速/乗船/高熱/鼓動/洗顔/授乳/浄水/脊髄

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、強風速時の事故を、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: So the police will be handling this high-wind accident case, won't they?
lines.style: Tentative, seeking confirmation. Quiet, deliberate pacing. Slightly rising inflection at the end—not quite a question but an opening for the officer to elaborate.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、密入国の乗船事案を担当します
lines.en: Yes. The police are taking on this illegal boarding case.
lines.style: Clear and measured. Slight formal register, no-nonsense delivery. Steady eye contact. Professional distance maintained throughout.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、容疑者の高熱症状を、警察、医療連携で扱われますね
lines.en: And regarding the suspect's high fever symptoms in this case—the police will be coordinating with medical services, correct?
lines.style: Careful phrasing, as if reading notes. Respectful but intent. A pause before the final phrase, double-checking the fact pattern.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、犯行時刻の心臓鼓動鑑定もおこないます
lines.en: That's right. We're also conducting cardiac forensics to establish the time of the crime.
lines.style: Factual, almost matter-of-fact. Short, clipped delivery. No emotion—just procedure. Efficient, like listing items on a checklist.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、洗顔料への異物混入事件を、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: This case also involves contamination in a washing product—the police are investigating that as well, aren't they?
lines.style: Hesitant, as if piecing together a complex situation. Soft voice. Slight pause before naming the final detail, like reaching for clarity.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、育児ネグレクトで授乳不足事案にも対応します
lines.en: Yes. We're also responding to cases of child neglect and insufficient feeding.
lines.style: Steady, unflinching. No softening of the serious subject matter. Professional delivery, slightly lower register. The words land without embellishment.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、浄水器悪用事件を、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: And this water purifier misuse incident—the police are handling that too, yes?
lines.style: Quieter still. Almost reflective, like thinking aloud. A very slight rise at the end, checking his understanding against what the officer has already confirmed.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、脊髄損傷を伴う暴行事件も厳しく捜査します
lines.en: We're investigating the assault case involving spinal cord injury with full urgency.
lines.style: Firmer than before. The word 'assault' gets slight weight. Jaw set. Professional concern without performance—this is serious and everyone should understand that.
